text: Korgus' Blackpowder Rifle drops from Overseer Korgus in Tol Dagor.
Korja the Butcher is a tortollan located in Nesingwary's Trek in Zuldazar.
Kraal Master B'khor is a Zandalari troll located in Zuldazar.
Korthek's Staff is a quest reward from The Fall of Emperor Korthek.
Korthek's Greatstaff is a quest reward from The Fall of Emperor Korthek.

Korthek's Students are sethrak located all over the Sacred Sands and the central part of the Skycallers' Spire in Vol'dun. Most of them are in groups, either roaming the area, standing around one of the great bonfires, or sitting near and listening to speaking Faithless Scrollkeepers, Skycallers, or Spireguards.
__NOTOC__ Korvash is a skeletal Drust located in Drustvar. He uses a fairly unique model for such a mob.
Korval Darkbeard is a Dark Iron dwarf pet tamer located in Nazmir. His pets are Feathers, Splat, and Brite.
Kory McMaster is an composer who created music for Warcraft Franchise.
Kotonga's Totem of Persuasion was to be provided for The Favor of Akil'darah.
__NOTOC__ Kora Gorekill is an orc located in Stonefist Watch in Tiragarde Sound.
Krag'wa's Ire is a plant named after Krag'wa the Huge, loa of the frogs. It can be found in blood troll territory in Nazmir. Sampling the plant will increase damage done by 15% for 5 minutes.
Koralune Keepsake is a unique-bound trinket found on the Broken Isles. May also come in other variants beyond "Uncommon", and may be available to level 101 and up.
Krasarang Gliders are rays located in the western waters of Krasarang Wilds. They typically swim in groups of two or three.
Krackleboom Bombs are bombs summoned by Siege Engineer Krackleboom in Boralus during the Faction Assaults.
Kramp't is a sea giant located at the Drowned Market in Nazjatar.
Kragg's Rigging Scalers drop from Skycap'n Kragg in Freehold.

Korrak's Revenge (or Alterac Valley Classic) is the PvP special event during WoW's Anniversary that puts players in the classic Alterac Valley. It is named after Korrak the Bloodrager. It was introduced with WoW's 15th Anniversary.

Krag'wa's Burrow is the sacred ground of Krag'wa, the frog loa, located in the Frogmarsh of eastern Nazmir. Unlike Torga's Rest, the area is mostly preserved from the blood troll threat. The loa is surrounded by his spawn, as well as other frogs.

Korj is a tortollan located at the Seekers' Expedition in Zuldazar. He guards the expedition grounds against troublemakers together with Dorj. Adventurers engaging in PvP combat near him, will find that they are quite persistent.
Krahf'thiyuz is a consumer of souls located in Brawl'gar Arena.
Korzaran the Slaughterer is a void revenant located at Vir'naal River Delta in Uldum.
Kor'thik Siegesmiths are mantid located in the Dread Wastes.
__NOTOC__ Kor'thik Deepblades are mantid located in Kor'vess in the Dread Wastes.
__NOTOC__ Kor'thik Saptenders are mantid located in the Dread Wastes.
__NOTOC__ Kor'thik Wingguards are mantid located in the Dread Wastes.
__NOTOC__ Korinna's Allaying Crook is at first located in Korinna's Reliquary in Bastion. When Zosime and the adventurer goes to fetch it, Kala swoops in, grabs it and flies off.
Koryfis is a steward located at the Cliffs of Respite in Bastion.
Kowalskos' Workshop is located south of the Eonian Archives in Bastion. It is the workshop of Kowalskos.
Koros is an Ascended kyrian located at the Eternal Watch in Bastion.
Korinna's Reliquary is a chamber located in the Garden of Respite in Bastion.

Kou is a steward who was taken captive by the House of Constructs during their attack on the Temple of Courage and was imprisoned in the Hall of Chains in Maldraxxus alongside Koa. After being freed by Aspirant Thales and the Maw Walker, Kou and Koa move to the House of Constructs' central ripening pond along with Thales, Secutor Mevix, and Hipokos. On Thales' request, they subsequently work with the Maw Walker to gather kyrian corpses from the area to prevent them from being turned into abominations. Kou and Koa escape the House of Constructs by riding on the Soulfused Construct along with the rest of the group and can subsequently be found defending the southern entrance to Spider's Watch
Korak's Reinforced Iron Tunic drops from Harbormaster Korak at the Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.

Korinna is a kyrian of old. Having long since passed, her memory is encountered in Korinna's Reliquary in Bastion. She will appear once the Vesper of Remembrance has been rung. She was among the first Ascended and was the one to first tame the creatures of Bastion using the Korinna's Allaying Crook. She created the Garden of Respite.
__NOTOC__ Kostas is a kyrian located in Elysian Hold in Bastion.
Koria is a dead kyrian located in Xandria's Vigil in Bastion.
Kraken Shell Pauldrons drop from Viq'Goth in the Siege of Boralus.
__NOTOC__ Kosarus the Fallen is a ghoul located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Korthian Relic Boxes are a set of four locked chests located in Korthia. They can be opened with a specific key, each purchased for 25 Cataloged Research from Archivist Roh-Suir at standing with the Archivists' Codex.
Kranal's Chestplate is a quest reward from Crossroads Caravan Pickup.
The Korthian Treat is provided as an objective for Think of the Critters.
Korayn's Javelin is provided as an objective for Down to Earth.
Korthian Gromits are gromits located near the unnamed central crossroads of Korthia, north of the Seeker's Quorum.

Korthite Crystals are potentially awarded from Korthia daily quests once they're unlocked as part of the Chains of Domination campaign. Blacksmiths, jewelcrafters, leatherworkers, and tailors use Korthite Crystals as a reagent for the Vestige of Origins. The Vestige is used to increase the base item level of Shadowlands legendary items crafted by the Runecarver.

Korthian Armaments is sold by Duchess Mynx at Keeper's Respite in Korthia for to players at standing with the Death's Advance. It also rarely drops from creatures or can be found in containers in Korthia. Open the container to loot a random upgradeable armor piece at item level 200, that can be upgraded all the way to item level 226 in exchange for Cataloged Research.

]] Korthite Crystal Key is purchased from Archivist Roh-Suir at Tier 2 for 25 Cataloged Research at the Reliquary of Remembrance at Keeper's Respite in Korthia. Use the key to open the Korthian Relic Box at in the small cave under Hope's Ascent.

Korthian Cypher Book can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 100 Cataloged Research and 50 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.

Korthia Awaits is offered to alts of players who have completed the first three chapters of the Chains of Domination campaign by becoming The True Maw Walker, opening the new Waystone to Oribos, and permanently fending off the Eye of the Jailer. The next quest begins the "The Last Sigil" chapter, at Renown (Shadowlands) 44.

Korthian Attendants are attendants located at various locations in Korthia. The few attendants who made it to Keeper's Respite are still alive, while the rest (at Sanctuary of Guidance, Scholar's Den, and Seeker's Quorum) have been killed by the invading Mawsworn.
Korthian Specimen is a gromit battle pet, occasionally dropped by Zelnithop in the back of Gromit Hollow on the Windswept Aerie of Korthia.

Korthite Crystal Waistguard is sold by Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance in Keeper's Respite of Korthia for 4,000 Cataloged Research at (exalted) standing with the Archivists' Codex faction.

Korthian Artifact drops from any Mawsworn in Seeker's Quorum while on Rescued from Torment or The Last Place You Look during the "They Could Be Anyone!" side chain of the Chains of Domination campaign. It starts Looting the Looters, which is also required to continue the chain.
Korthite Crystal Geode is sold at the Hall of Holding in Oribos by for and for .

Kraklaa's Hatchery was a planned subzone in Azsuna. It was likely a name for either the cave in which Queen Kraklaa is found, or the underwater area outside, as it happens to be full of eggs.
Korrim's Journal might have belonged to Korrim the Cunning at the Blighted Scar in Maldraxxus.
Koroleth's Crackling Dagger drops from Balakar Khan in the Nokhud Offensive. It is named after Koroleth, Balakar's Primalist ally.
Korrikunit the Whalebringer is a tuskarr located in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.
Krakz Cloudgrease is a goblin located on the Defiant Dragonscale in Durotar.
Kozastran is a dracthyr located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. She is reading a map.
Korky is a vulpera located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.

Krakle's Trigger Paw drops from Huntmaster Krakle in the Azure Span.
Korvik is a tuskarr located in Iskaara in the Azure Span. He informs on the arrival of Old Belfyr.
__NOTOC__ Kranac Sagesnow is a furbolg located in Winterpelt Hollow in the Azure Span.
Koslahki is a black drakonid located in Obsidian Rest in Zaralek Cavern. A Junior Warden can be found sitting on a nearby table.
Koya Windtotem is a tauren located in Toghusuq Village in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She carries a baby tauren on her.
Kovki is a red drakonid child located at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
__NOTOC__ Korvelnor is a dracthyr located in the Azure Span.

Krazek is a goblin quest giver formerly located in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He describes himself as secretary to Baron Revilgaz, and has been involved in manufacturing mechanical cooking pots under the brand Krazek's Crock Pot and delivering supplies and information to various people. By the time of the Cataclysm, Krazek has relocated himself to Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn. When the Zandalari attacked the camp, he was cowering in fear.

__NOTOC__ Kriss Goldenlight is a high elf found reading scrolls in the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. She was once found chatting with Aurora Skycaller just below Quel'Lithien Lodge in the Eastern Plaguelands, until the elves of the lodge became wretched. She later showed up in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Krullaran the Prophet is the only permanent centaur resident in Maraudon. The centaur of Desolace turn to the khans for protection, but they looked to him for guidance. Many believe he communes with the titans and possesses insight to the glorious return that the centaur will someday make to the northern lands.
__NOTOC__ Kresh is a turtle that wanders along the river near the beginning of the Wailing Caverns instance. Kresh is tameable by hunters.

Krueg Skullsplitter is an orc quest giver located in Camp Mojache in Feralas. He was initialy found in Thousand Needles. He moved there after receiving the appropriate orders from his masters in Orgrimmar. One of them, , has taken a special interest in the Grimtotem tauren and wanted to see them exterminated, although the reasons for his hatred remain a mystery. Krueg is either unable or unwilling to explain it. (The Grimtotems are foul creatures though, and just about everyone hates them with the exception of the Forsaken.) Krueg loves his life-mate Korrin deeply and was recently seen looking for adventurers willing to help him fashion a new cloak for her made entirely of precious Iridescen

Krusk is an orc quest giver located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He was one of the agents dispatched by Warchief Thrall to investigate the activities of the Syndicate in the area, as well as to recover an object of importance from the Durnholde Keep. Krusk's mission was initially a failure after he was ambushed and outnumbered by Syndicate forces in the Keep. Though he escaped, his companions Gol'dir, Drull and Tog'thar were captured and held in the Keep. He sought adventurers to help locate the captives and free them. Since the Cataclysm, he sends the adventurers to the Eastpoint Tower. He came to the center of the town to see the arrival of Orkus and Kasha. During the Legion

Krog is an orc quest giver located in Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh. He was dispatched by the Warchief to investigate the burning of the Shady Rest Inn. At some point, the Earthen Ring had awarded him with armor crafted by Mosarn.
Kris of Unspoken Names is part of the Implements of Unspoken Names set.
Krastinov's Bag of Horrors is part of the quest chain, leading to the Spectral Essence, an item that allows contact with the spirits in Caer Darrow.
Krom Stoutarm is a dwarf warlock and quest giver located in the Library in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. He was later made the heirloom vendor for the Alliance.
__NOTOC__ Krol Blade is a main hand sword that is highly sought after by Warriors and Rogues that do not raid thanks to its high top damage and bonus to critical chance.

Krinkle Goodsteel is a goblin blacksmithing vendor located in Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He can be found near the forge and anvil on the south side of the town. He was present during the Legion Invasions. He provided armor to the defenders.
Krolg is a furbolg quest giver located at Krolg's Hut south of Mystral Lake in Ashenvale. Krolg is an uncorrupted furbolg and was once part of the Foulweald tribe.
Krethis the Shadowspinner is a rare spider found roaming in and around the cave in the Skittering Dark in Silverpine Forest. She is on a 1.5-2.5 hour respawn timer.

Kreenig Snarlsnout is a Razormane quilboar found east of Thorn Hill in the Northern Barrens. Kreenig is the leader of a band of quilboar since he was sent from Razorfen Kraul. He is a skilled raider and a large threat to the Far Watch Post. As such, he has a bounty on his tusk. Horde players of appropriate level are commissioned to take him down, along with his immediate subordinates.
Kromcrush's Chestplate is a plate chest armor piece primarily for tanks.
Kreldig Ungor is a dwarf quest giver located at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

The Krenka tribe (aka Krenka clan) is a small centaur clan found in the Barrens. Among the beliefs of the small Krenka tribe is that every animal in the Barrens has a "guiding spirit" that controls its actions and destiny. By venerating a guiding spirit, a tribe can gain the blessing of that guiding spirit. Although similar ideas appear in many tribal cultures, the Krenka take this to extremes, going so far as to construct elaborate idols and following various ceremonies aimed at pleasing the Barren's spirits. Ancient tales say that when Krenka grew old he wandered out into the Barrens to die, but promised to return to aid his people if the need was great. To this day, centaur who grow too o
Kregg Keelhaul is a rare mob goblin found in Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris. He does not give any Steamwheedle Cartel reputation when killed.

Kryll was a goblin who served Deathwing during the time between the Second and Third Wars. His voice held tones of mischief and madness, his skin was emerald green, and his grin was madcap, with long and very sharp teeth, and an almost forked blood-red tongue. His eyes were narrow and yellow with no visible pupils, and his hair was dull brown ridge of fur that rose up from behind his neck and finished as a wild crest above his squat forehead. Although he was wiry and narrow, his body was also muscular. Kryll was a skilled alchemist and engineer, and giggled a lot, especially when foul work was afoot. His two chief passions were experimentation and mayhem, and whenever possible he combined th

Krenka was the founder of the Krenka clan. According to ancient tales, when Krenka grew old he wandered out into the Barrens to die, but promised to return to aid his people if the need was great. To this day, following his example, those centaur who grow too old or injured to fight leave the tribe to die alone, their fates never known by their people. He later became a risen centaur warrior in the adventure "Shrine of the Scarab" found in the book Horde Player's Guide. As a risen centaur warrior, he could speak Common and Krenkese.
Krosh Firehand is an ogre-magi that belongs to High King Maulgar's council of ogres.
Kris of Orgrimmar is a quest reward from Hidden Enemies (4).
__NOTOC__ Krugosh is an orc master mining trainer located at Thrallmar in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Kreeg's Stout Beatdown can be purchased for from in Dire Maul.

Kristen Dipswitch is a gnome quest giver located at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand. She is only available at certain times, when she is not off hunting for skins. She will come walking out of Windyreed Pass, and get attacked by an assassin at the safari.
Kravel's Crate is provided as an objective for Hemet Nesingwary Jr. (quest).
Kravel's Parts are provided as an objective for Delivery to the Gnomes.
*Kravel's Scheme is provided as an objective for Back to Booty Bay from at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles.
Kraul Guano drops from Kraul Bats and Greater Kraul Bats in Razorfen Kraul.
Krasus's Compendium - Chapter 1 can be found in Kirin'Var Village in the Netherstorm.
Krasus's Compendium - Chapter 2 can be found in Kirin'Var Village in the Netherstorm.
Krasus's Compendium - Chapter 3 can be found in Kirin'Var Village in the Netherstorm.
Kron's Amulet drops from Dreadmaw Crocolisks and Corrupted Dreadmaw Crocolisks in Southfury River in Durotar.
Krixil Slogswitch is a goblin fruit and drink vendor located in Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.
Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk drops from Kreenig Snarlsnout in the Northern Barrens.

__NOTOC__ Kraz was one of the NPCs that players saved while doing the Timed Event in Zul'Aman. Players saved him by killing the Dragonhawk aspect boss Jan'alai before the timer ran out. Once freed, he armed a bomb on the nearby chest, blasting it open and causing players standing nearby to get a small knockback. The loot given depended on the order the players killed the bosses in, more info can be found at the Zul'Aman timed event page. In the expansion World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King, Kraz moved from Zul'aman to Northrend as a quest giver in a small camp on the Northeastern area of Grizzly Hills. Fellow Zul'aman timed event prisoner Harkor can also be found at this camp.
Krom Stoutarm's Treasure is looted from Krom Stoutarm's Chest in Uldaman.
Kritok was a goblin tinker who commanded many goblin slaves. He was killed by the gnome Shomei.

__NOTOC__ Kreug Oathbreaker is a flesh giant located at the Carrion Fields in the Dragonblight. He was responsible for the death of Illusia Lune's husband, children and friends (the "Whisperveils"); later, she posted a wanted poster to have him killed.
Krystallus is a boss in the non-linear instance of Halls of Stone. He is an enormus colossus at the end of the cavern-like room.
Krolmir, Hammer of Storms is part of the Sons of Hodir quest chain.
Krastinov's Work Bench can be found behind Doctor Theolen Krastinov in Scholomance.
Kristen Smythe is a forsaken grand master blacksmithing trainer at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
__NOTOC__ The Krol Cleaver is a thematic update to the Krol Blade. It is also the only "cleaver" in the game that is not an axe.

:Zombies serve as mindless muscle in the Pit of Saron's mines, stockpiling metals for Forgemaster Garfrost, and Krick - a devious leper gnome - supervises the operations from atop Ick, Krick's ghastly means of transportation. Krick and Ick are a gnome and a plague eruptor in league with the Lich King and serve as bosses encountered in the Pit of Saron inside the second wing of the Frozen Halls. Their death is the objective of the Frozen Halls storyline quest Deliverance from the Pit (Alliance) / (Horde).
Krick's Beetle Stabber drops from Krick and Ick in Pit of Saron.
Krennan's Potion of Stealth is a quest item for Betrayal at Tempest's Reach.
Krom'gar Flame Thrower is provided for Ashes to Ashes (Horde).
Krom'gar General's Insignia is provided for Betrayal at the Grove.
Kron's New Hunting Bag is a quest reward from the post-cataclysm version of Lost But Not Forgotten (Durotar).

Krenk Choplimb is a goblin first aid trainer located at Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara. He used to reside in Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar where he was handling a small infirmary with Brother Silverhallow. He was tenting to Injured Siegeworkers. Following the construction of Orgrimmar Embassy, he was moved to Azshara with other displaced goblins. He can still be seen there before allied races are unlocked. Krenk also appears in the Theramore's Fall scenario as the field surgeon aboard The Sea Wolf.
Krazek's Oven Mitts is a quest reward from Venture Company Mining (Alliance).

__NOTOC__ Krastinovian Carvers are humans and undead, appearing after the Chamber of Summoning in Scholomance. Killing a carver within 10 yards of another carver cause their bloodthirst to spread to that carver, increasing its stack. They are students of the rare Theolen Krastinov, and have been surgically altered to look like him.
Krasari Stalkers are tigers located in the Zhu Province of Krasarang Wilds. They are also in A Little Patience.

Kri'vess is the northern kypari tree on the mainland of Townlong Steppes. Surrounded by the Underbough, mantid have come to Kri'vess in the form of Kri'thik Boneslicers and screamers. Tai Ho is on a quest to figure out why the mantid are so far afield and why they are attacking so violently.

Krokk is a stealthed Horde operative and quest giver in Ashenvale. He is in charge of getting a blood elf diplomat out of Warsong Lumber Camp. He only appears when the player uses Secret Signal Powder at the Smoldering Brazier outside Satyrnaar.
The Krom'gar Caravan Hauler is a Tauren. He drives the Krom'gar Wagon which can take players from Silverwind Refuge to The Fold during the quest We're Here to Do One Thing, Maybe Two....

The Krom'gar Wagon is a wagon driven by the Krom'gar Caravan Hauler. It serve as an easy transport from Silverwind Refuge to The Fold during the quest We're Here to Do One Thing, Maybe Two.... It is being pulled by a War Kodo.
Krik'thik Swarmers are mantid located at the Gate of the Setting Sun in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Krik'thik Needlers are mantid located at the Gate of the Setting Sun in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Krik'thik Locust-Guards are mantid located at the Gate of the Setting Sun in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Kri'chon is an amber scorpion located at the Gate of the Setting Sun in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Krik'thik Hivelings are mantid located at the Horrid Marchin the Dread Wastes.
Krik'thik War Wagons are war wagons located at the Horrid March in the Dread Wastes.
Krik'thik Catapults are catapults located at the Horrid March in the Dread Wastes.

Krosh's Back is found on the corpse at the top level of the Pools of Purity in the Valley of the Four Winds. It begins the quest Guess Whose Back.
__NOTOC__ Kri'thik Aggressors are mantid located at Gai-Cho Battlefield in Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Kri'thik Screechers are mantid located at Gai-Cho Battlefield in Townlong Steppes.
Krol the Blade is a rare mogu found in the Dread Wastes. He is a Pandarian champion.

__NOTOC__ A Kroshik devilsaur can be found circling the filth-pool of Ihgaluk Crag. Nearby Skumblade tribe saurok will stop what they're doing and turn to face him if he is close. Occasionally, Kroshik will die and will be dragged to the altar at on the beach to be torn into by most members of the tribe. A day or so later, a Kroshik egg will be tended at Progenitus' spawn position on top of the crag. A few days after that, a baby Kroshik will be born and can be found wandering the crag. According to Akolik, Thok the Bloodthirsty is Kroshik, defiled and twisted. Bowing before all four forms of Kroshik is the requirement of the Pandaria quest achievement When in Ihgaluk, Do as the Skumblade Do

__NOTOC__ Krokul Hovel is a small enclave in Krokuun where the Broken resistance led by Chieftain Hatuun took refuge. This is where many of the broken slaves from Darkfall Ridge have hidden after being freed during the initial invasion of Argus. Turalyon was taken there and mended by the krokul after his ship, the Xenedar crashed.
Krokuun is a region of Argus where the armies of Azeroth first landed during their quest to stop the Burning Legion. Kil'jaeden's Legion ship has crashed here near the Xenedar.
Krokul Wranglers are Broken located in Krokuun. They keep watch and patrol the upper grounds of the Petrified Forest. They ride Cragscaler Steeds. Their commander is Lead Rider Jerek.
Krokul Ridgestalker are stealthed Broken guards located in Krokul Hovel in Krokuun. They can also be summoned during Threat Reduction.
Krokul Guardians are krokul located at Krokul Hovel on Krokuun. After their alliance with the Army of the Light, some of them can also be found on the Vindicaar.
Krokul Crushers are krokul located at Krokul Hovel on Krokuun.
The Krokul Emergency Cache can be found in a cave west of the Crown of Destruction in Krokuun.
